blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Industrial content moderation must process massive message streams under tight latency constraints, yet most abusive language (AL) detection systems rely on sentence-level classification (ALC), which neither localizes abusive spans nor identifies who is targeted.
We define Abusive Language Identification (ALI) as a sequence-labeling task that jointly extracts AL spans and target mentions, and assess whether this approach can be used for text moderation.
On a pilot corpus drawn from a production moderation pipeline, we compare ALI with ALC on cross-domain generalization and implicit abuse, and we also evaluate AL and target span detection.
ALI remains competitive with ALC while providing localized outputs for moderators, with a modest and configuration-sensitive advantage on implicit abuse.
Exact AL boundaries and target spans remain difficult to recover.
We complement this comparison with a qualitative analysis and discuss perspectives on complete target–span linking and on structured benchmarks for ALI.
blocks.zh:
工业内容节制必须在紧迫性制约下处理大量信息流,但大多数滥用语言(AL)的检测系统依赖于句子级别分类(ALC),这种分类既不能将滥用时间段本地化,也不能确定谁是目标。
我们把滥用语言识别(ALI)定义为一个顺序标记的任务,共同提取AL的跨度和目标,并评估这种方法是否可用于文本节制.
关于从生产节制管道中抽取的试采体,我们把ALI与ALC比较,说明跨域泛化和隐含的滥用,我们还评估AL和目标跨度检测。
ALI仍然与ALC具有竞争力,同时为主持人提供本地化产出,在隐性滥用上具有适度且对配置敏感的优势.
准确的AL边界和目标跨度仍然难以恢复。
我们用定性分析来补充这一比较,并讨论关于完全目标-范围联系和ALI结构化基准的观点。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Warning: This paper contains offensive content and may be distressing.
blocks.zh: 警告: 本文含有冒犯性内容,可能令人不快.

blocks.en:
Industrial content moderation operates under severe throughput constraints: major social media platforms and thematic forums generate volumes of text that make exhaustive human review impossible 1 1 1 2025 estimates put the number of short daily messages on major micro-blogging platforms at over 500 million, and daily contributions on community forums at several million. .
Operators must process massive streams of messages within tight latency budgets, while still identifying content that may require differentiated action, from standard removal to priority escalation and protective follow-up Guillén-Nieto (2023) .
In this context, detection systems must deliver not only speed and scale, but outputs that are directly actionable for analysts who are not experts.
blocks.zh:
工业内容节制在严重的吞吐量限制下运作:主要社交媒体平台和专题论坛生成大量文本,使得详尽的人文审查无法进行 11 1 2025 估计,主要微博平台每天短信息的数量超过5亿个,社区论坛的每日贡献为数百万个. 。 。 。 。
运营商必须在紧凑的即时预算范围内处理大量信息流,同时确定可能需要有区别行动的内容,从标准删除到优先升级和保护性后续Guillén-Nieto(2023年).
在这方面,探测系统必须不仅提供速度和规模,而且提供可直接用于非专家分析员的产出。

blocks.en:
Most research on abusive language (AL) detection remains framed as Abusive Language Classification (ALC) Basile et al. (2019) ; Zampieri et al. (2019) ; Röttger et al. (2021) .
ALC assigns a single label to an entire message, but does not localize which spans constitute AL nor explicitly identify targeted entities.
This limits operational usefulness when a single message contains multiple abusive instances, when only part of a text is harmful, or when the moderation response depends on who is targeted Ashraf et al. (2020) ; Pandya et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh:
大多数关于虐待语言(AL)检测的研究仍被设定为:阿布西语分类(ALC) Basile等 (2019).;Zampieri等 (2019).;Röttger等 (2021).
ALC为整个消息指定了单一的标签,但没有将构成AL的长度本地化,也没有明确指明目标实体。
这限制了在单一信息包含多重滥用情况、文本只有一部分有害、或温和反应取决于针对谁Ashraf等人(2020年)的情况下,操作的实用性。

blocks.en:
Recent work has moved toward finer-grained annotation schemes. Zampieri et al. (2023) introduced target-based offensive (TBO) language, bridging sentence-level harmfulness labels with token-level annotations of offensive arguments and their targets.
JL-Hate Büyükdemirci et al. (2024) further proposes joint token-level detection of hate/offensive spans and target entities.
Inspired by these works, we propose the Abusive Language Identification (ALI) task as a native sequence labeling formulation that jointly extracts AL spans and target mentions, together with explicit links between them.
blocks.zh:
最近的工作已转向更细致的说明计划。 Zampieri等人(2023年)引入了基于目标的攻击(TBO)语言,将句子级的有害性标签与对攻击性论点及其目标的象征性级别说明相接.
JL-Hate Büyükdemirci等人(2024年)还进一步提议对仇恨/犯罪跨度和目标实体进行联合象征性检测。
受这些作品的启发,我们提议将 " Abusive Language Information " (ALI)任务作为一种原生的序列标签配方,共同取出AL的横幅和目标,以及它们之间的明确联系。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we design a pilot corpus for ALI, which covers all categories of AL, from abusive terms and offensive speech to threats and hate speech, as well as other forms of abusive language encountered in industrial moderation.
We evaluate ALI in out-of-domain settings due to the lack of a dedicated ALI dataset.
The main purpose of this paper is to assess whether an ALI-based approach can be used for text moderation.
To this end, we compare ALI and ALC along two axes.
We first focus on cross-domain generalization , as models trained on one annotation scheme or platform rarely remain robust on unseen corpora Karan and Šnajder (2018) ; Arango et al. (2019) ; Yin and Zubiaga (2021) .
We also examine implicit AL 2 2 2 The detailed implicit and explicit AL analysis is reported in Appendix B because of paper-length limits. , where harmful intent is conveyed without overt slurs and remains particularly difficult to detect Wiegand et al. (2021) ; Sap et al. (2020) ; ElSherief et al. (2021) .
We hypothesize that ALI better captures such cases than ALC by localizing relational cues in context, such as pairing a seemingly benign phrase with a specific addressee, rather than relying on isolated lexical signals at the message level.
We also assess AL and target span detection, since a moderation decision depends on localizing the abusive content and identifying who is targeted.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们为ALI设计了一个实验性指令,涵盖AL的所有类别,从辱骂和攻击性言论到威胁和仇恨言论,以及工业节制中遇到的其他形式的辱骂性语言.
由于缺乏专用的ALI数据集,我们在域外环境下评价ALI.
本文件的主要目的是评估是否可以采用基于ALI的方法来节制文本。
为此,我们按照两个轴线对ALI和ALC进行比较。
我们首先关注跨域泛化, 因为接受过一个注释计划或平台训练的模型,
我们还审查隐含的AL 2 2 附录B中由于纸张长度限制而报告了详细的隐含和明示的AL分析。 ,在不露出口水的情况下传达出有害意图,并且仍然特别难以发现Wiegand等人(2021年);Sap等人(2020年);El Sherief等人(2021年)。
我们假设ALI比ALC更好地捕捉这类情况,办法是在上下文中将关系提示本地化,例如将一个看似良性的短语与特定的收件人配对,而不是依赖电文层面孤立的词汇信号.
我们还评估AL和目标范围,因为温和的决定取决于将虐待内容本地化和确定目标对象。

blocks.en:
Our results indicate that ALI remains competitive with ALC in cross-domain settings while offering natively interpretable span-level outputs for moderators, and may offer some advantage on implicit abuse, where contextual cues matter more than isolated lexical signals, although gains are modest and configuration-sensitive.
Span detection itself remains challenging: exact AL boundaries are difficult to recover and target spans are likewise hard to delimit.
We conclude that sequence labeling is a viable alternative to ALC for industrial moderation, and discuss perspectives on complete target-span linking and on structured benchmarks for ALI.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果表明,在跨域环境中,ALI仍然与ALC具有竞争力,同时为主持人提供本土可解释的跨级产出,并可能在隐含滥用方面提供一定优势,因为背景提示比孤立的词汇信号更重要,尽管收益不大,而且对配置敏感。
松散探测本身仍然具有挑战性:准确的AL边界很难恢复,目标跨度也很难划定。
我们的结论是,序列标签是替代ALC的工业温和的可行办法,并讨论关于完全目标范围联系和ALI结构化基准的观点。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
AL detection. Most research on AL detection explores the problem as an ALC task Waseem and Hovy (2016) ; Davidson et al. (2017) ; Founta et al. (2018) ; Basile et al. (2019) ; Zampieri et al. (2019) .
Shared tasks and evaluation benchmarks have consolidated this paradigm Basile et al. (2019) ; Röttger et al. (2021) , while surveys highlight persistent challenges in definition, bias, and evaluation Yin and Zubiaga (2021) ; Fortuna et al. (2022) ; Jahan and Oussalah (2023) .
Transformer-based encoders pretrained or fine-tuned on AL corpora remain the dominant modeling choice Caselli et al. (2020) ; Caselli et al. (2021) ; Sarkar et al. (2021) ; Awal et al. (2021) .
Although effective for screening, ALC provides limited actionable structure: it neither localizes AL spans nor explicitly highlights targeted entities, limiting its usefulness for operational moderation workflows that require differentiated responses Guillén-Nieto (2023) .
blocks.zh:
AL检测. 大多数关于AL检测的研究将该问题作为ALC的任务来探讨,Waseem和Hovy(2016年);Davidson等人(2017年);Founta等人(2018年);Basile等人(2019年);Zampieri等人(2019年)。
共同的任务和评价基准巩固了这一范例Basile等人(2019年);Röttger等人(2021年),而调查突出了定义、偏见和评价Yin和Zubiaga(2021年);Fortuna等人(2022年);Jahan和Oussalah(2023年)。
基于变形器的编码器在 AL corpora 上经过预训或微调,仍然是主要的模型选择 Caselli 等 (2020年); Caselli 等 (2021年); Sarkar 等 (2021年); Awal 等 (2021年).
ALC虽然对筛选有效,但提供了有限的可操作结构:它既没有将AL横跨地方,也没有明确地突出目标实体,限制了它对业务温和工作流程的用处,这些工作流程需要不同的应对措施Guillén-Nieto(2023年)。

blocks.en:
Span-level sequence labeling. Beyond ALC, an increasing number of corpora adopt token-level sequence labeling to localize harmful content directly in text.
The SemEval-2021 shared task on toxic span detection Pavlopoulos et al. (2021) formalized this paradigm by training models to identify the minimal textual units responsible for a toxicity label.
HateXplain Mathew et al. (2021) also provides token-level labels, but these annotations remain secondary to the sentence-level class and are not designed as a standalone identification task.
More recently, LLM-based pipelines have been proposed to produce span-level labels Nirmal et al. (2024) , yet still derive spans from a predefined classification decision rather than from native structured annotation.
Across these resources, labeled spans are typically very short (often single tokens), omit target identification, and do not cover a unified taxonomy of abuse types (threats, hate speech, non-targeted profanity).
blocks.zh:
Span-level 序列标签. 除了ALC之外,越来越多的corpora采用标志级序列标签,直接将有害内容在文本中本地化.
SemEval-2021共同承担了检测毒害范围的任务Pavlopoulos等人(2021年),通过培训模型,确定毒性标签的最小文本单位,使这一模式正式化。
仇恨解释 Mathew等 (2021) 也提供了符号级的标签,但这些说明仍然处于句子级的次要地位,并不是作为独立的识别任务来设计的.
最近,有人提议以LLM为基础的管线生产跨级标签Nirmal等人(2024年),但仍从预先确定的分类决定中而不是从本土结构化注释中得出跨度。
在这些资源中,被贴上标签的跨度通常非常短(往往是单一的标志),省略了目标识别,没有涵盖虐待类型的统一分类(威胁、仇恨言论、非有针对性的亵渎)。

blocks.en:
Target-aware AL resources. Identifying who is attacked is increasingly recognized as essential, especially for threats, hostility, and hate speech directed at individuals or groups Ashraf et al. (2020) ; Vidgen et al. (2021) ; Pandya et al. (2025) .
Recent corpora jointly annotate aggressiveness and target categories at the span level Damo et al. (2025) , reflecting growing interest in structured, target-aware sequence labeling beyond sentence-level harmfulness. Barbarestani et al. (2022) extend HX with span-level target communities, but these target annotations are not explicitly linked to the corresponding AL spans.
JL-Hate Büyükdemirci et al. (2024) proposes joint learning of hate/offensive spans and target entities in English and Turkish, yet does not model explicit associations between an AL span and its target mention. Zampieri et al. (2023) introduce target-based offensive (TBO) language, annotating offensive arguments together with their targets and bridging sentence-level harmfulness with token-level structure. Atil et al. (2026) introduce TRuST, which merges prior social-media and LLM-generated resources under a unified scheme for binary toxicity, a social-group target (8 coarse / 24 fine labels), and toxic spans, with a human-annotated subset of about 11k examples.
Unlike JL-Hate and TBO, TRuST targets are categorical group labels rather than token-level mentions.
blocks.zh:
目标意识AL资源. 人们日益认识到,确定谁受到攻击至关重要,特别是针对Ashraf等人的威胁、敌意和仇恨言论(2020年);Vidgen等人(2021年);Pandya等人(2025年)。
最近的公司在Damo等一级联合说明攻击性和目标类别。 (2025),反映了对结构化,目标意识序列标签超过句子级有害度的兴趣不断增长. Barbarestani等人(2022年)将HX扩展至跨级目标社区,但这些目标说明并未与相应的AL跨度明确相联.
JL-Hate Büyükdemirci等人(2024年)建议用英语和土耳其语共同学习仇恨/攻击的横幅和目标实体,但并没有在AL横幅与目标提及之间形成明确联系的模式。 Zampieri等人(2023年)引入了基于目标的攻击(TBO)语言,将攻击性的论点与目标一起标注起来,用象征级的结构来弥补句子级的危害. Atil等 (2026年)引入了TRuST,将之前的社会-媒体和LLM生成的资源在一个二进制毒性的统一方案下合并,一个社会团体目标(8粗/24个细标签)和有毒的跨度,其中人类附加说明的子集约11k个实例.
与JL-Hate和TBO不同,TRuST的目标都是绝对的团体标签,而不是象征级的提及.

blocks.en:
Cross-domain generalization. A recurring finding is that ALC models generalize poorly across corpora and platforms Karan and Šnajder (2018) ; Arango et al. (2019) ; Caselli et al. (2020) ; Yin and Zubiaga (2021) ; Antypas and Camacho-Collados (2023) .
Domain adaptation via unsupervised fine-tuning on the target distribution Bose et al. (2021) and multi-task training across heterogeneous datasets Yuan and Rizoiu (2025) partially mitigate this issue, but performance remains sensitive to annotation scope and label definition mismatches.
These observations motivate our cross-domain evaluation comparing ALI and ALC.
blocks.zh:
跨域通论. 一个反复出现的调查结果是,ALC模型在公司内部和平台 Karan和Šnajder(2018年)、Arango等人(2019年)、Caselli等人(2020年)、Yin和Zubiaga(2021年)、Antypas和Camacho-Collados(2023年)上普遍情况不佳。
通过对目标分布Bose等人(2021年)进行无监督的微调和跨多类数据集的多任务培训进行域名调整,从元和里佐乌(2025年)部分缓解了这一问题,但性能对注释范围和标签定义不匹配仍然敏感.
这些意见促使我们进行跨领域评价,比较ALI和ALC。

blocks.en:
Implicit AL. Implicit abuse, where harmful intent is conveyed without overt slurs, remains a major bottleneck Sap et al. (2020) ; Wiegand et al. (2021) ; ElSherief et al. (2021) .
The Implicit Hate Corpus (IHC) ElSherief et al. (2021) explicitly separates implicit and explicit hateful messages, showing ties between implicit abuse and stereotypical knowledge.
Models trained without such phenomena struggle to detect them at inference time Yin and Zubiaga (2021) ; Caselli et al. (2020) .
Recent studies continue to stress the difficulty of implicit formulations in web and conversational settings Boudraa et al. (2025) ; Carvallo et al. (2025) .
Span-level modeling is a plausible response to this challenge: localizing abuse and its target may capture relational cues (e.g., pairing a benign-looking phrase with a specific addressee) that ALC models miss Wiegand et al. (2021) .
Building on prior works, we deliberately include implicit discourse in our pilot corpus and provide an evaluation on this type of AL.
blocks.zh:
隐性AL. 隐性滥用,如在不露出口水的情况下传达有害意图,仍然是Sap等人(2020年);Wiegand等人(2021年);El Sherief等人(2021年)的一个主要瓶颈。
《隐性仇恨(IHC)El-Sherief等人》(2021年)明确区分了隐含和明确的仇恨信息,显示了隐含的虐待与陈规定型知识之间的联系。
培养的模型没有这种现象挣扎,在推断出殷和祖比亚加的时间(2021年); Caselli等 (2020年) .
最近的研究继续强调网络和对话环境Boudraa等人(2025年);Carvallo等人(2025年)中隐含配方的困难。
平面模型是应对这一挑战的一个合理办法:将滥用及其目标本地化可能捕捉到相关提示(例如,将一个良性-外观的短语与特定的收件人配对),而ALC models miss Wiegand等人(2021年))。
在以往工作的基础上,我们有意将隐含的论述纳入我们的试验大纲,并对此类AL作出评价。

blocks.en:
LLMs for AL detection. LLMs have been explored for AL detection through fine-tuning Sen et al. (2024) , prompting Ghorbanpour et al. (2025) , retrieval augmentation Mnassri et al. (2025) , and synthetic data generation Schmidhuber and Kruschwitz (2024) .
While promising on benchmark tasks, their computational and environmental cost remains a barrier for large-scale, low-latency moderation pipelines Fortuna et al. (2022) .
Our experiments therefore focus on encoder-based sequence labeling models, which offer more deployable trade-off between accuracy and inference cost while delivering structured, interpretable outputs.
blocks.zh:
AL检测的LLMs. 通过微调Sen等人(2024年),LLMs被探索用于AL检测,并提示了Ghorbanpour等人. (2025), retriferation Mnassri等 (2025),并合成数据生成出施密德胡伯和克鲁施维茨 (2024).
虽然在基准任务方面很有希望,但其计算和环境成本仍然是大规模低纬度温和管道的障碍(2022年)。
因此,我们的实验侧重于以编码器为基础的序列标签模型,这些模型在提供结构化、可解释的产出的同时,在准确性和推论成本之间提供了更可部署的取舍。

blocks.en: 3 Proposed methodology
blocks.zh: 3 拟议方法

blocks.en:
In this section, we detail the methodology of our ALI approach, designed to meet the constraints of large-scale analysis.
Our goal is to produce structured predictions, AL spans associated with their targets, offering better readability for operators who are not NLP experts.
Unlike ALC approaches that provide a simple binary label, our methodology draws on work in targeted sentiment analysis Orbach et al. (2021) and aims to locate problematic elements precisely in the text as proposed by Zampieri et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们详细介绍了我们为应付大规模分析的制约而设计的ALI方法。
我们的目标是提出结构化的预测,与指标相联系的AL跨度,为非NLP专家的操作者提供更好的可读性.
与提供简单二进制标签的ALC方法不同,我们的方法借鉴了目标情感分析Orbach等人(2021年)的工作,并旨在如Zampieri等人(2023年)所提议,在案文中准确地找到有问题的内容。

blocks.en:
We present here the full definition of the ALI task, including the taxonomy and annotation protocol; although our full methodology integrates explicit linking between AL spans and their targets (arrows in Figure 1 ), the empirical evaluation focuses on the first step, detecting AL spans, to establish a rigorous comparison with ALC approaches.
Complete evaluation of target–span linking and its impact on moderation decision-making is deferred to future work, once the pilot corpus is extended.
blocks.zh:
我们在此提出ALI任务的全面定义,包括分类和注释协议;尽管我们的全面方法将AL跨与目标之间的明确联系(如图1所示)融为一体,但实证评估侧重于第一步,即探测AL跨度,以便与ALC方法建立严格的比较。
一旦试点机构扩大,对目标-范围联系及其对温和决策的影响的全面评估将推迟到未来工作。

blocks.en:
Task description. Our approach consists of natively identifying AL spans and corresponding target spans in a text, establishing explicit links between them.
This structuring differs fundamentally from existing approaches: HX Mathew et al. (2021) uses token-level annotations only for post-hoc explainability of ALC models, while Pavlopoulos et al. (2021) is limited to very short toxic spans (approximately 1 word) without target identification.
Our methodology covers all types of AL, from non-targeted profanity to hate speech, and can capture longer contextual spans, with on average 3 (implicit AL) to 7 (explicit AL) AL tokens per abusive message, essential for characterizing implicit AL.
blocks.zh:
任务说明. 我们的方法包括在案文中以本土方式确定AL的跨度和相应的目标跨度,在它们之间建立明确的联系。
这种结构与现行办法大相径庭: HX Mathew等 (2021年)仅对ALC模型的后可解释性使用符号级说明,而Pavlopoulos等 (2021年)则仅限于极短的毒性跨度(约1个字),没有目标识别.
我们的方法涵盖所有类型的AL,从非针对性的亵渎到仇恨言论,并且可以捕捉较长的背景跨度,平均每条侵权信息平均有3个(隐性AL)到7个(显性AL)AL标志,对于描述隐性AL至关重要.

Figure 1: Annotation examples for each class: Abusive terms , Offensive speech , Threat , and Hate speech .
Text highlighted in blue designates the target, and other highlighted text designates AL (shown here to the left of the sentences). The arrow represents the association between AL and its target.
blocks.zh:
图1:每一类的说明示例: 攻击性言论、威胁和仇恨言论。
以蓝色突出显示的文本指定了目标,而其他突出显示的文本则指定了AL(在句子左侧显示). 箭头代表了AL与其目标的联系.

blocks.en: To cover all phenomena encountered in industrial context, we define four AL categories, illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 为了涵盖工业领域遇到的所有现象,我们界定了四个AL类别,如图1所示。

blocks.en:
Abusive terms are vulgarities and insults not directed at a specific entity.
Our definition stands out by explicitly integrating this non-targeted category, often ignored in binary approaches; it avoids false positives on intensifier uses, as in “He’s a fu*king good player”, where fu*king is annotated as Abusive terms with no target link.
blocks.zh:
污名词是粗俗和侮辱,不是针对特定实体。
我们的定义很突出,它明确地将这一非目标类别纳入其中,在二进制方法中常常被忽略;它避免了在强化器使用上出现虚假的正值,如在“他是一个富*正玩家 ” 中,fu*正被注解为没有目标联系的被滥用术语。

blocks.en:
Offensive speech encompasses targeted personal insults, disrespect, or ironic denigration Davidson et al. (2017) ; Mathew et al. (2021) .
We explicitly extend this category to ironic denigration, a subtle form of targeted disrespect rarely detected unless annotated.
blocks.zh:
攻击性言论包括针对个人的侮辱、不尊重或讽刺地诋毁Davidson等人(2017年);Mathew等人(2021年)。
我们明确将这一类别扩大到具有讽刺意味的诽谤,这种微妙的有针对性地不尊重行为,除非附加说明,否则很少被发现。

blocks.en:
Threat covers expressions of moral or physical harm against a target Ashraf et al. (2020) ; Vidgen et al. (2021) , including hypothetical, subtle, and conditional formulations.
In Figure 1 , “I think, he will kill you” is annotated as Threat even though the harm is reported rather than directly uttered: in an operational setting, such a threat remains informative and relevant to strategic decision-making.
Isolating directed threats is essential for operational moderation, where responses may go beyond standard content removal.
blocks.zh:
威胁包括针对目标Ashraf等人(2020年);Vidgen等人(2021年)的精神或身体伤害,包括假设、微妙和有条件的表述。
在图1中,“我认为,他会杀了你”被注解为“威胁”,尽管损害是报告而不是直接表达的:在行动环境中,这种威胁仍然是信息,与战略决策相关。
隔离定向威胁对于行动适度至关重要,因为应对可能超出标准内容去除范围。

blocks.en:
Hate speech denotes incitement to violence, hatred, or discrimination based on protected characteristics (race, religion, gender, etc.) Basile et al. (2019) ; Caselli et al. (2020) .
We distinguish it from Offensive speech and Threat by the nature of the underlying discourse.
blocks.zh:
仇恨言论指基于受保护特征(种族、宗教、性别等)而煽动暴力、仇恨或歧视 Basile等 (2019年); Caselli等 (2020年).
我们把它与攻击性言论和威胁区分开来,因为其基本言论的性质。

blocks.en: Corpus creation. We built a pilot corpus of 1002 texts from our production moderation pipeline, fed by several public social media platforms combining micro-blogging and thematic discussion forums 3 3 3 Our pilot corpus is available for academic collaborations under a confidentiality agreement (NDA). To support reproducibility, we release the experiment code and fine-tuned models at URL . The collection strategy aimed to maximize diversity of AL phenomena while ensuring representativeness of cases encountered in industrial moderation.
blocks.zh: 公司创造。 由多个公共社交媒体平台提供, 并结合微博和专题讨论论坛3 3, 为了支持可复制性,我们发布了实验代码和URL的微调模型. 收集战略旨在尽量扩大AL现象的多样性,同时确保在工业节制时遇到的案例具有代表性。

blocks.en:
No community is targeted by default: the collection objective is to cover every type of abusive discourse, without restricting the sample to any particular community.
Data selection combined flagged keywords with neutral messages from general feeds to balance the distribution, and an automatic pre-filtering step that retained undetected messages specifically to evaluate ALI on ambiguous and implicit cases.
blocks.zh:
任何社区都不存在默认目标:收集目标是涵盖每一种虐待言论,而不将样本局限于任何特定社区。
数据选择将标有标记的关键词与来自一般种子的中性消息合并,以平衡分布,以及自动预过滤步骤,它保留了未被检测到的信息,专门用于评价模糊和隐含情况下的ALI.

blocks.en:
The two professional annotators, one man and one woman, have a background in NLP annotation for sentiment analysis, and the expert annotator adjudicated disagreements to produce the finalized labels 4 4 4 The authors actively participated in the annotation as expert annotators. .
The man annotator has a background in threats annotations, and the woman annotator has a novice for this annotation task.
A formation session was conducted to familiarize the annotators with the ALI task and the annotation protocol, and the annotation conditions took the annotators’ well-being into account.
blocks.zh:
两名专业的注释员,一男一女,在NLP注释中有一个背景,用于情绪分析,专家注释员裁定分歧,以制作最终的标签. 页:1 4 提交人作为专家注释员积极参加了注释。 。 。 。 。
男方的注释员在威胁说明中有一个背景,而女方的注释员对这个注释任务有一个新意.
举行了一次组建会议,使注释者熟悉ALI的任务和注释协议,注释条件考虑到了注释者的福祉。

blocks.en:
The resulting corpus was annotated according to the ALI protocol described above.
It covers detection of AL spans and their associated targets (level 1), as well as classification according to whether the AL is implicit or explicit.
Among the 1002 finalized texts, 542 contain explicit AL, 123 implicit AL (requiring contextual interpretation to identify abusive character), and 337 are neutral.
Inter-annotator agreement is computed over three annotators: one expert and the two professional annotators.
The mean Cohen’s κ \kappa across pairwise comparisons Cohen (1960) reaches 0.52 for sentence-level AL presence and 0.47 for targets, and drops to 0.38 at the token level.
Although this figure falls below the threshold often considered moderate agreement and therefore injects noise into the ALI training signal, it reflects the intrinsic difficulty of span-boundary and subcategory decisions; comparable span-labeling corpora report similarly constrained agreement despite simpler schemes (e.g., SemEval-2021 toxic spans Pavlopoulos et al. (2021) ).
We provide more detailed statistics by category in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
根据上文所述的ALI议定书,对由此产生的文书作了说明。
它涵盖了AL跨度及其相关目标(一级)的探测,以及按AL是隐含的还是明示的分类.
在已定稿的1002个案文中,542个载有明确的AL、123个默示AL(要求根据背景作出解释,以查明滥用性),337个是中立的。
通知人之间的协议由三个通知人计算:一名专家和两名专业通知人。
平均 Cohen 的 & kappa 横跨对等比较 Cohen (1960年) 的 AL 值为 0.52 , 而 AL 值为 0.47 , 在符号值则降至 0.38 。
虽然这一数字低于通常被认为是适度协议的阈值,因此给ALI培训信号注入了噪音,但它反映了跨边界和分类别决定的内在困难;可比的跨标签公司报告,尽管有更简单的计划(例如,SemEval-2021毒性跨出Pavlopoulos等人(2021年))。
附录A按类别提供了更详细的统计数据。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the models and datasets used to compare the ALI and ALC tasks, as well as training parameters.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们描述了用于比较ALI和ALC任务的模式和数据集以及培训参数.

blocks.en: 4.1 Language models
blocks.zh: 4.1 语文模式

blocks.en: We fine-tuned three models based on transformers commonly used in the AL domain. RoBERTa-large Liu et al. (2019) is used as a generalist reference model, without specific pre-training on AL, allowing us to evaluate the contribution of the ALI task independently of pre-fine-tuning on abusive data. HateBERT Caselli et al. (2021) is a BERT variant fine-tuned on a large AL corpus covering various forms of offensive language. fBERT Sarkar et al. (2021) is also a BERT variant, fine-tuned on a corpus of more than 9 million offensive messages, enabling it to capture subtle abusive content.
blocks.zh: 我们根据AL域常用的变压器对三种型号进行了微调. 大型 RoBERTa 软件 刘等 (2019年)被作为通论参考模型,没有关于AL的具体预训,使我们能够独立于对滥用数据的预精调来评价ALI任务的贡献. HateBERT Caselli等人(2021年)是BERT的变体,在涵盖各种形式的攻击性语言的大型《联邦法典》上进行了微调。 fBERT Sarkar等人(2021年)也是BERT的变体,对900多万条攻击性信息进行了微调,使其能够捕捉出微妙的滥用内容.

blocks.en:
Training parameters. For each model, we perform 3 training runs with varying random seeds.
Training is capped at 50 epochs with early stopping (patience of 5 epochs) and a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} .
blocks.zh:
培训参数。 每种模式,我们进行三次随机种子不同的训练。
培训的上限为50个学分,提前停止(5个学分的空间),学习率为10 - 5 10 - 5。

blocks.en: 4.2 Training sets
blocks.zh: 4.2 培训

blocks.en:
We describe below the corpora used to fine-tune the models on the two tasks studied.
We did not retain the corpus of Pavlopoulos et al. (2021) because annotated spans are mostly isolated lexical units (average length ≈ \approx 1 word), incompatible with our goal of capturing contexts for implicit AL.
blocks.zh:
下面我们描述的是用来微调所研究的两项任务的模型的公司。
我们没有保留Pavlopoulos et al. (2021),因为注解的跨度大多是孤立的语法单位(平均长度为 \\\\ 1 word),不符合我们捕捉隐含的AL的背景的目标.

blocks.en:
Our proposed corpus. In line with the literature on implicit AL detection ElSherief et al. (2021) , we initially distinguish implicit and explicit classes in annotation, but merge them for ALI/ALC comparison experiments, as ALC cannot distinguish these nuances.
We split the corpus into 80% training / 20% validation.
blocks.zh:
我们提出的程序 根据关于隐性AL检测El-Sherief等(2021)的文献,我们最初在注释中区分了隐性与显性类,但将它们合并为ALI/ALC比较实验,因为ALC无法区分这些细微差别.
我们把尸体分成80%的培训 20%的鉴定

blocks.en: For the ALI task, we use a standard sequential labeling scheme IO where label I marks lexical units that are part of an AL span, and O the rest of the text. For the ALC task, we consider a text abusive if it contains at least one I unit. To ensure a fair comparison, we apply the same heuristic in post-processing on ALI predictions (a text is positive if the model predicts at least one AL token), allowing use of the same metrics as ALC.
blocks.zh: 对于ALI任务,我们使用一个标准的相继标签方案IO,标签I标记属于AL跨度的词典单位,而O则表示文字的其余部分. 就国际法委员会的任务而言,我们认为,如果案文至少包含一个I单位的话,就是一种滥用。 为了确保公平比较,我们在对ALI预测进行处理后采用同样的heuristic(如果模型预测至少一个AL令牌,则一个正文),允许使用与ALC相同的度量衡.

blocks.en:
HateXplain corpus. Since our corpus is small ( n = 1002 n=1002 ), we also use HateXplain Mathew et al. (2021) , named here (HX), to validate the ALI approach at larger scale ( ≈ \approx 17k sentences).
This corpus contains token-level annotations (rationales) justifying the classification decision, which we reinterpret as AL spans for the ALI task.
blocks.zh:
仇恨诉讼 由于我们的体型很小(n = 1002 n = 1002),我们也使用HateXplain Mathew 等 (2021),在这里取名 (HX),在更大的尺度上验证ALI方法(\\\\\ 大约17k句).
这套文书载有象征性说明(说明),说明作出分类决定的理由,我们将其重新解释为AL跨度,用于ALI任务。

blocks.en:
However, HX exhibits heterogeneity in annotations: rationales vary significantly between annotators.
For example, two annotators may agree on the hateful label while highlighting entirely different spans as the justification.
For the ALI task, we randomly extract a single justification per text to simulate standard sequence labeling annotation.
Furthermore, some texts annotated as abusive have no rationale; in those cases, we treat them as negative for ALI training (no detectable span).
blocks.zh:
然而,HX在说明中表现出了异质性:说明者之间的原理差异很大.
例如,两位注释者可能就可恨的标签达成一致,同时强调完全不同的跨度作为理由。
对于ALI任务,我们随机抽取每个文本的单一理由来模拟标注的标准序列.
此外,一些附加说明为滥用的文本没有任何理由;在这些情况中,我们对ALI培训视之为否定(无法检测)。

blocks.en:
We use the standard HX split (15k train / 2k val), with 59.4% abusive texts.
The same preprocessing and post-processing are applied to HX and our corpus to ensure methodological uniformity.
blocks.zh:
我们使用标准的HX分数(15k列车 / 2k val),使用59.4%的滥用文本.
同样的预处理和后处理适用于HX和我们的文件,以确保方法的统一。

blocks.en:
Target-based offensive corpus. We also use the corpus provided by Zampieri et al. (2023) to evaluate the generalization of ALI vs ALC.
The corpus combines sentence-level harmfulness labels with token-level annotations of offensive argument spans and their associated targets.
At the token level, each unit is labeled as part of an offensive argument, as a target entity, or as outside any span.
We apply the same preprocessing and post-processing as for previously described corpora to ensure methodological uniformity.
Unfortunately, only the training set is publicly available; we split it into 80% training and 20% validation sets for our experiments.
blocks.zh:
攻击目标 我们还利用Zampieri等人(2023年)提供的委托书来评价ALI诉ALC的概况。
主体将句子级的有害性标签与标语级的冒犯性争论跨度及其相关目标说明相合并.
在象征层面,每个单位被标注为攻击性争论的一部分,被标为目标实体,或者在任何跨度之外.
我们采用与前述公司相同的预处理和后处理,以确保方法的统一。
不幸的是,只有这些培训是公开的;我们把培训分为80%的培训,20%的测试。

blocks.en:
Training combination. We study the impact of merging the two corpora HX and TBO (each merged independently) with our pilot corpus for training.
We anticipate that ALI models will be more sensitive to these training combinations than ALC models, due to the greater specificity of the token-level annotation objective (risk of inconsistency in spans between the two sources).
blocks.zh:
训练组合。 我们研究将两个公司HX和TBO(各自独立合并)与我们的试点机构合并以进行培训的影响。
我们预计,由于符号级注释目标更为具体(两个来源之间可能存在不一致),ALI模型对这些培训组合比ALC模型更敏感.

blocks.en: We also experimented with automatic annotation via generative LLMs 5 5 5 Mistral-Nemo, LLaMa-3.3-70B, Qwen2.5-32B; precision < < 70% on an internal validation sample. but results were insufficient for direct integration, probably due to the complexity of implicit/explicit disambiguation; a dedicated study is left to future work.
blocks.zh: 我们还通过基因说明LMS 5 5 5 Mistral-Nemo、LLaMa-3.3-70B、Quen2.5-32B、精确度 < 70%进行自动注释试验。 但是,结果不足以直接整合,这可能是由于隐含/明显混淆的复杂性;一项专门研究留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation sets and metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3 成套评价和衡量标准

blocks.en:
We evaluate our models in an out-of-domain configuration on HatEval, IHC, JL-Hate, and TRuST, to measure generalization of ALI vs ALC.
We do not evaluate on the corpus provided by Zampieri et al. (2023) because the test set is not publicly available.
However, we provide sequence labeling evaluation on the JL-Hate and TRuST corpora because they contain token-level annotations of AL spans.
blocks.zh:
我们用HatEval、IHC、JL-Hate和TRuST的域外配置来评价我们的模型,以衡量ALI对ALC的概括。
我们不评估Zampieri等人提供的证据(2023年),因为测试资料不公开。
然而,我们提供JL-Hate和TRuST公司的序列标签评估,因为它们包含了AL跨度的符号级说明.

blocks.en:
HatEval corpus. We use the test set of Basile et al. (2019) (approximately 2900 sentences annotated for hate speech detection).
For comparison with ALI, we binarize predictions (hateful = abusive, non-hateful = neutral).
This dataset is standard for evaluating generalization Arango et al. (2019) ; Caselli et al. (2020) ; Yuan and Rizoiu (2025) , notably because it contains counter-responses to hate speech (counter-discourse) that sometimes use abusive language, a textbook case for testing model robustness.
We do not use this corpus for span-level analysis, because it has no token-level annotations.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2018-09-21). HatEvalebol. 我们使用Basile等人(2019年)的测试集(约2900个句子附加了仇恨言论侦测的说明).
与ALI相比,我们将预测(仇恨=虐待,非仇恨=中性)二分法化.
本数据集是评价通俗化的Arango等(2019年); Caselli等(2020年);Yuan和Rizouiu(2025年)的标准,特别是因为它包含了对仇恨言论(反对话)的反反应,有时会使用虐待语言,这是测试模型稳健性的教科书案例.
我们不使用这个工具来进行跨级分析,因为它没有符号级的说明。

blocks.en:
IHC corpus. This corpus ElSherief et al. (2021) is annotated in three classes: non-hateful , explicit hateful , and implicit hateful .
We randomly sample 1000 texts per class and merge explicit/implicit classes into a single abusive class for ALI/ALC comparison.
IHC enables fine-grained analysis of implicit AL detection, a key phenomenon for validating the interest of ALI.
We do not use this corpus for span-level analysis, because it has no token-level annotations.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2018-10-21). IHCault. El-Sherief等人(2021年)在三个类别中作了说明:不恨人、明显的仇恨和隐含的仇恨。
我们随机抽取每类1000个文本,并将显性/隐性类合并为一个滥用类,用于ALI/ALC比较.
IHC能够对隐含的AL检测进行精细分析,这是验证ALI利益的关键现象.
我们不使用这个工具来进行跨级分析,因为它没有符号级的说明。

blocks.en:
JL-Hate corpus. JL-Hate Büyükdemirci et al. (2024) combines three sentence-level classes ( non-abusive , offensive , hateful ) with token-level annotations of AL and target spans.
We use the full English subset (765 sentences) as an out-of-domain evaluation set: models are never trained on this corpus.
Sentence-level evaluation follows the same protocol as HatEval and IHC (merged abusive class; ALI post-processed for macro-F1).
We additionally use this corpus for span-level evaluation based on AL and target spans.
blocks.zh:
JL -Hateborator. (英语). JL-Hate Büyükdemirci等 (2024) 将三个句子等级(非刺激性,攻击性,可恨性)与符号等级的AL说明和目标跨.
我们用完全的英语子集(765句)作为域外评价集:模型从未受过关于这本书的培训.
句子级别评价遵循与HatEval和IHC(混合虐待类;ALI后为宏-F1处理)相同的协议.
此外,我们还根据AL和目标跨度进行跨度评估。

blocks.en:
TRuST corpus. TRuST Atil et al. (2026) unifies prior social-media and LLM-generated resources under a common scheme for binary toxicity, targeted social groups, and toxic spans.
We use its human-annotated test split (982 texts).
Sentence-level evaluation follows the same protocol as the other corpora, with binary toxicity mapped to our abusive / non-abusive labels and unsure texts excluded.
Span-level evaluation is restricted to AL spans because targets are annotated as categorical groups rather than spans.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2019-10-12). TruSTect. TRUST 软件 Atil等人(2026年)根据二元毒性、目标社会群体和毒性跨度的共同计划,统一了社会媒体和LLM产生的资源。
我们使用其人为附加说明的试验分拆(982个文本)。
判决级别的评价遵循了与其他公司相同的协议,其二进制毒性被映射到我们的滥用/非破坏标签上,并且排除了不确定的文本.
泛层评价仅限于AL跨度,因为目标被附加为绝对组而不是跨度.

blocks.en:
Evaluation metrics. For sentence level evaluation, we report macro-F1 , standard in abusive language detection Basile et al. (2019) ; Caselli et al. (2020) .
For ALI, we derive a sentence-level label by binarizing token predictions: a text is abusive if at least one token is predicted as AL.
This post-processing yields the same sentence-level macro-F1 for ALI and ALC on HatEval, IHC, JL-Hate, and TRuST.
For each system, we select the run with the median macro-F1 among three random initializations, then compare ALI and ALC predictions on each test set with a significance test Gillick and Cox (1989) at a 5% level.
blocks.zh:
评价尺度。 关于句子级别评价,我们报告macro-F1,滥用语言检测标准Basile等人(2019);Caselli等人(2020)。
对ALI来说,我们通过将符号预测二进制得出句子级别标签:如果至少一个符号被预测为AL的话,文本是滥用的.
这种后处理为HatEval、IHC、JL-Hate和TRuST上的ALI和ALC产生相同的句子级宏F1。
对于每个系统,我们从三个随机初始化中选择以宏-F1中位数运行,然后将每个测试集的ALI和ALC预测与意义测试Gillick和Cox(1989年)以5%的水平进行比较.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Span level obtained results
blocks.zh: 5.1 所取得成果

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares standard ALI and with target models on JL-Hate and TRuST ( Ours , TBO ).
An exhaustive analysis of all training settings (including HX and other training combinations) is provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
表1比较了标准ALI以及JL-Hate和TRuST(我们的,TBO)上的目标模型.
附录D详尽分析了所有培训环境(包括HX和其他培训组合)。

Bold text marks the best score for each F1 type within a backbone, and the † symbol is used to indicate that the corresponding score is significantly better than the other scores of the same backbone.

blocks.en:
AL span detection. Across backbones, TBO-based training yields the highest F1-exact and F1-token, while training on our corpus with target supervision can lead on F1-partial (Table 1 ).
F1-exact stays well below F1-partial and F1-token on both JL-Hate and TRuST, remaining below 30 30 %.
The target head does not help uniformly: for RoBERTa trained on our corpus it raises F1-exact and F1-partial ( 22.53 22.53 vs 19.22 19.22 ; 56.67 56.67 vs 53.95 53.95 ), while F1-token remains slightly higher without it ( 69.04 69.04 vs 68.16 68.16 ).
Combining our corpus with TBO brings no further gain, probably because the two annotation schemes are too dissimilar.
On TRuST test set, we observe that F1-token falls to 47.07 47.07 – 51.17 51.17 % from an F1-partial of 59.45 59.45 – 66.00 66.00 %, because some texts are annotated as entirely toxic: F1-partial credits any overlap, while F1-token penalizes every unmarked gold token.
blocks.zh:
AL跨度检测。 在整个骨干部门,以TBO为基础的培训产生最高的F1-精确度和F1-托肯度,而关于我们受目标监督的教程的培训则能够导致F1-部分(表1)。
F1-精确度在JL-Hate和TRuST上都远远低于F1-部分和F1-端,仍低于30%.
目标头没有统一帮助:对于接受过我们人身训练的RoBERTA来说,它提高了F1-精确度和F1-局部度(22.53 22.53对19.22 19.22;56.67 56.67对53.95 53.95),而没有F1-托肯仍然略高(69.04 69.04对68.16 68.16)。
把我们的体能和TBO结合起来没有进一步的好处,可能因为这两个注解方案太相异了.
在TRuST测试中,我们观察到F1-token从F1-部分的59.45 59.45–66.00 %下降到47.07 47.07 — 51.17 51.17%,因为有些文本被注解为完全有毒: F1-部分记分,任何重叠,而F1-token惩罚每一个没有标记的金币.

blocks.en:
Target detection. Target spans are annotated only on JL-Hate.
TRuST labels targets as categorical groups rather than spans, so no target-span score can be reported.
With target supervision, Ours (with target) is the strongest configuration for fBERT and significantly better than the other with-target rows of that backbone ( † ).
For HateBERT and RoBERTa, gaps against the other with-target trainings are not significant under this best-vs-all criterion.
RoBERTa still reaches the highest target scores, at 31.13 31.13 F1-exact, 43.35 43.35 F1-partial, and 70.45 70.45 F1-token on our corpus.
Despite the small size of our pilot corpus, these results suggest that our annotation scheme provides relevant supervision for joint AL and target span detection.
blocks.zh:
目标探测 目标跨度只在JL-Hate上注出.
TRuST将目标标为绝对组而不是跨度,因此无法报告目标-span分.
在目标监督下,我们的(有目标)是FBERT最强的配置,并且大大优于主干线的另一条有目标行(-).
对于HateBERT和RoBERTA来说,根据这一最佳Vs-所有标准,与其他目标培训相比差距不大。
RoBERTA仍然达到最高目标分数,31.13 F1-精确,43.35 F1-部分,70.45 70.45 F1-token在我们身上。
尽管我们的试点机构规模很小,这些结果表明,我们的注释计划为联合AL和目标跨度检测提供了相关的监督。

blocks.en: Overall, accurately detecting both AL and target spans remains highly challenging, particularly when exact boundaries are required.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,准确检测AL和目标跨度仍然极具挑战性,特别是在需要准确的界限时。

blocks.en: 5.2 ALI vs ALC
blocks.zh: 5.2 ALI诉ALC

blocks.en:
We compare ALI and ALC on cross-domain generalization and robustness on implicit AL; sentence-level ALI labels are derived by binarizing token predictions (a text is abusive if at least one token is predicted as AL).
Table 2 focuses on the three single-source trainings ( Ours , HX , TBO ) to isolate the ALI vs ALC contrast on HatEval, IHC, JL-Hate, and the TRuST.
The full resutl grid is reported in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
我们比较ALI和ALC关于跨域通论和对隐含的AL的强性;句子级ALI的标签是通过将符号预测二进制得到的(如果至少预测一个符号为AL的话,一个文本是滥用性的).
表2侧重于三个单一源培训(Ours, HX, TBO),以隔离ALI与ALC在HatEval, IHC, JL-Hate和TRuST上的对比.
完整的还原网格见附录C。

blocks.en: Table 2: Median macro-F1 ± \pm std (%, 3 runs) of ALI and ALC trained on single sources. Average per task is the mean of the nine medians (published HatEval scores excluded). Bold text marks the best score for each approach within a model and test set; the ∗ symbol is used to indicate that the corresponding score is significantly better in the ALI–ALC comparison for the same training setting, and the † symbol is used to indicate that it is significantly better than the other training settings of the same model and approach.
blocks.zh: 表2:经单一来源培训的ALI和ALC的中度宏F1 ±\pm std (%, 3跑). 每个任务的平均值为9个中位数的平均值(不包括已公布的HatEval分数). 粗体文字在一个模型和测试集内标出每种方法的最佳分数;*符号用于表示相应的分数在ALI–ALC的同一种训练环境的比较中明显好一些,而Q符号用于表示它明显优于同一模型和方法的其他训练环境.

blocks.en:
Average ALI vs ALC trend. Although ALI natively outputs token-level labels and is evaluated here via post-processing for comparability with ALC, it matches or surpasses ALC across test sets (Table 2 , Average per task row).
The largest gaps appear on JL-Hate ( 69.49 69.49 % vs 57.27 57.27 %; + 12.2 +12.2 ) and TRuST ( 71.18 71.18 % vs 59.70 59.70 %; + 11.5 +11.5 ), then IHC ( 63.94 63.94 % vs 53.57 53.57 %; + 10.4 +10.4 ), while HatEval remains closer ( 56.31 56.31 % vs 52.77 52.77 %; + 3.5 +3.5 ), consistent with the sequence-labeling design on span-rich corpora.
Under RoBERTa + HX, ALI remains competitive in this “degraded” sentence-level setup ( 65.58 65.58 % vs 65.06 65.06 % on HatEval; 69.98 69.98 % vs 66.82 66.82 % on IHC; 71.51 71.51 % vs 65.50 65.50 % on JL-Hate), confirming that span-level detection does not degrade global detection while adding interpretability.
On HatEval, RoBERTa ALI reaches 65.58 65.58 % macro-F1, surpassing the 64.5 64.5 % previously reported by Yuan and Rizoiu (2025) , despite providing localized outputs.
The best ALC score on this set is fBERT with HX training ( 67.87 67.87 % macro-F1).
blocks.zh:
平均ALI对ALC的趋势. 虽然ALI在本土上输出了符号级标签,并通过处理后评估与ALC的可比性,但它与ALC相匹配或超过测试集(表2,每个任务行的平均值)。
最大的差距出现在JL-Hate(69.49 69.49 % vs 57.27 57.27%;+ 12.2 + 12.2)和TRuST(71.18 71.18% vs 59.70 59.70%;+ 11.5 + 11.5),然后是IHC(63.94 63.94% vs 53.57 53.57%;+ 10.4 + 10.4 + 10.4),而HatEval仍然比较接近(56.31 56.31% vs 52.77 52.77%;+3.5 + 3.5),这与在宽体上测序标签设计一致.
在RoBERTa + HX下,ALI在这种“被降级”的量刑级别设置中仍然具有竞争力(HatEval为65.58 65.58%对65.06 65.06%;IHC为69.98 69.98%对66.82 66.82%;JL-Hate为71.51%对65.50 65.50%),证实跨级检测在增加可解释性的同时不会降解全球检测.
在哈特瓦尔,罗贝塔ALI达到65.58 65.58%的宏-F1,超过了袁和里祖乌(2025年)先前报告的64.5 64.5%,尽管提供了局部产出.
本集的最佳ALC分数是FBERT的HX训练(67.87 67.87%的宏-F1).

blocks.en:
Robustness under TBO and limited data. ALC collapses under TBO training on several configurations (e.g., HateBERT on IHC: 27.41 27.41 %; JL-Hate: 41.12 41.12 %; TRuST: 36.29 36.29 %), whereas ALI remains stable ( 59.46 59.46 %, 73.07 73.07 %, and 71.21 71.21 %, respectively).
This gap likely stems from a distributional mismatch: TBO annotates targeted offensive spans, whereas IHC and JL-Hate evaluate broader or differently structured AL phenomena.
ALC appears to overfit TBO’s global harmfulness decision, whereas ALI retains transferable local cues even when the training domain differs.
Training on our corpus alone ( n = 800 n=800 ) yields lower HatEval scores ( 52 52 – 56 56 % macro-F1 for ALI), as expected given size and class imbalance, but ALI suffers less from data restriction than ALC in several cases (e.g., HateBERT on IHC: 60.66 60.66 % ALI vs 48.83 48.83 % ALC; RoBERTa ALC standard deviation up to 13.9 13.9 on IHC).
blocks.zh:
在TBO和有限数据下的强健性. 在TBO的几种配置培训下,ALC崩溃(例如,IHC上的HateBERT:27.41 27.41%;JL-Hate:41.12 41.12%;TRuST:36.29 36.29%),而ALI保持稳定(分别为59.46 59.46%、73.07 73.07%和71.21 71.21%)。
这一差距可能源于分布不匹配: TBO对目标攻击的跨度进行注释,而IHC和JL-Hate则评价范围更广或结构不同的AL现象.
ALC似乎过于适应TBO的全球有害决定,而即使培训领域不同,ALI仍保留可转让本地提示。
仅仅关于我们人身的培训(n = 800 n = 800)就得出了较低的HatEval分数(52 52 – 56 56%的宏观-F1 = ALI),正如预期的大小和班级不平衡,但是在几个情况下,ALI受到的数据限制比ALC少(例如,IHC上的HateBERT:60.66 60.66%的ALI对48.83 48.83%的ALC;RoBERTa ALC标准偏差可达13.9 13.9的IHC)。

blocks.en:
Backbone differences and training combinations. HX is the strongest single-source training for HatEval and IHC across backbones, while TBO remains competitive for ALI on JL-Hate (HateBERT: 73.07 73.07 %).
We hypothesize that RoBERTa-large’s stronger results reflect its larger number of trainable parameters relative to HateBERT and fBERT.
Effects of merging corpora ( Ours + HX , Ours + TBO , TBO + HX , Ours + TBO + HX ) are reported in Appendix C : combinations with TBO often degrade ALI on IHC and HatEval, whereas combining our pilot corpus with HX can further improve IHC and JL-Hate.
Appendix B further reports implicit and explicit AL detection on IHC; under settings without TBO, ALI outperforms ALC on implicit AL (+ 3.6 3.6 macro-F1; 61.42 61.42 % vs 57.86 57.86 %) without trading off explicit AL detection (+ 2.1 2.1 ).
blocks.zh:
后骨差异与训练组合. HX是HatEval和IHC跨主干线最强的单源培训,而TBO在JL-Hate(HateBERT:73.07 73.07%)上仍然对ALI有竞争力.
我们假设RoBERTa的更强成果反映了比HateBERT和fBERT更多的可训练参数。
合并公司的影响 (我们的+HX,我们的+TBO,TBO+HX,我们的+TBO+HX,我们的+TBO+HX)在附录C中被报告:与TBO的结合经常会降低IHC和HatEval上的ALI,而将我们的实验程序与HX结合则能进一步改善IHC和JL-Hate.
附 录 B进一步报告隐含和明示的AL检测在IHC上;在没有TBO的情况下,ALI在隐含AL(+ 3.6 宏-F1; 61.42 61.42% vs 57.86 57.86%)上的AL检测在不交换显性AL检测(+ 2.1.2.)的情况下,ALI比ALC的绩效要好.

blocks.en: 6 Qualitative analysis
blocks.zh: 6 定性分析

blocks.en:
In this section, we conduct a qualitative analysis by examining predictions on a few samples from the IHC corpus.
We base our analysis on the RoBERTa model, as it obtained the best macro-F1 scores among training sets and tasks used on the IHC test set.
Furthermore, the RoBERTa model has no pre-training on AL, which makes it useful for conducting this analysis.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们通过审查对《国际环境卫生标准》的一些样本的预测,进行定性分析。
我们的分析以RoBERTA模式为基础,因为它在IHC测试集中使用的成套培训和任务中获得了最好的宏观-F1分数.
此外,RoBERTA模式没有关于AL的预训,因此有助于进行这一分析。

blocks.en:
Unlike ALC, ALI natively localizes AL in text and therefore does not rely on post-hoc explanation methods, making predictions more directly interpretable for non-expert analysts.
For comparison, we apply LIME Ribeiro et al. (2016) to ALC models to highlight the words most influential for the classification decision, and contrast these post-hoc explanations with ALI span predictions.
Figure 2 illustrates this comparison on two examples from the IHC test set.
blocks.zh:
与ALC不同的是,ALI本土在文本中将AL本地化,因此不依赖后荷克解释方法,使得预测更直接地被非专家分析师解释.
为了进行比较,我们将LIME Ribeiro等人(2016年)应用于ALC模型,以突出对分类决定最有影响力的词,并将这些后浩克解释与ALI的跨度预测作对比.
图2以国际环境卫生标准测试组的两个例子说明了这一比较。

blocks.en:
Figure 2: Example outputs for RoBERTa ALI and ALC models trained on different corpora. For ALC models, LIME explanations are shown: words highlighted in orange tend to predict AL, and those highlighted in blue the opposite (normal discourse). The more a word is highlighted, the more impact it has on the class predicted by the ALC model.
For ALI models, ALI predictions are highlighted.
Both examples shown are from the IHC test set.
blocks.zh:
图 2: RoBERTa ALI和ALC模型的示范产出,就不同的公司进行了培训。 对于ALC模型,LIME解释显示:以橙色突出的词倾向于预测AL,而以蓝色突出的词则相反(通常的会话). 单词越被强调,对ALC模型预测的类的影响就越大.
对于ALI模型,则强调ALI预测.
这两个例子都取自IHC测试集.

blocks.en:
Labeling divergence and its effect on explanations. On the first sample (top of Figure 2 ), we note that the verb “ hate ” is ignored by the ALI model trained on HX, unlike the other models. This is probably due to the low proportion of annotation of this term in HX data: only 24% of lexical units “ hate ” are considered rationales in the training set, vs 41% in our training set.
Furthermore, we observe the impact of labeling divergences between the two training sets: on the LIME output, we note that “ hate ” contributes less to class prediction when the model is trained on the HX training set.
When models are trained on TBO Zampieri et al. (2023) , we observe a pronounced shift in focus between ALI and ALC: ALI localizes offensive arguments in context, whereas ALC explanations remain concentrated by focusing on the wrong interpretation of the text.
These observations suggest that span-level ALI annotation, guided by a consistent taxonomy, can mitigate lexicon-driven biases inherited from training corpora and support more reliable AL localization when several abusive phenomena co-occur in the same text.
blocks.zh:
标出分歧及其对解释的影响。 在第一个样本(图2上方)中,我们注意到“仇恨”动词被接受HX训练的ALI模型所忽略,与其他模型不同。 这可能是由于HX数据中对这一术语的注解比例较低:只有24%的词汇单位“仇恨”被认为是培训集的理由,而我们的培训集则有41%。
此外,我们还注意到将两套培训中的差异贴上标签的影响:对LIME产出,我们注意到,当模型接受HX培训时,“仇恨”对班级预测的作用较小。
在TBO Zampieri等人(2023年)接受模型培训时,我们看到ALI和ALC之间的重点明显转变: ALI在上下文中将攻击性论点本地化,而ALC的解释仍然集中于对案文的错误解释。
这些意见表明,在前后一致的分类学指导下,跨级ALI注释可以减轻从培训公司中继承下来的由词典所驱动的偏见,并且支持比较可靠的AL本地化,因为在同一文本中,有若干滥用现象共同存在。

blocks.en: The second sample further illustrates cross-corpus annotation divergence: “ shut up ” is labeled AL in fewer than 13% of HX training instances, versus systematically in our corpus, visibly shifting the LIME explanations. With TBO-trained models, a complementary contrast emerges: ALI marks offensive argument spans, whereas ALC concentrates on target mentions.
blocks.zh: 第二个样本进一步说明了跨公司的注释差异:在不到13%的HX培训案例中,“闭嘴”被贴上AL的标签,而在我们的教程中则有系统,明显地改变了LIME的解释。 与TBO训练的模型形成互补对比: ALI标志着攻击性争论的跨度,而ALC则专注于提及目标。

blocks.en:
Distinction of AL subcategories. With our training set, most errors arise because models are not trained to distinguish AL subcategories, even though our annotation scheme defines four types: Abusive terms , Offensive speech , Threat , and Hate speech (section 3 ).
In “ no woman has the right to kill an unborn baby! it’s not her body it’s the baby’s body she’s choosing to kill. open your eyes !!! ”, the model correctly identifies “ choosing to kill ” as AL, but without subcategory supervision it cannot assign it to Threat .
This is nonetheless a minor error in practice, since the span itself is appropriately localized.
blocks.zh:
AL子类的区分. 随着我们的培训,大多数错误都会出现,因为模型没有经过培训来区分AL亚类,尽管我们的注释计划定义了四种类型: 攻击性言论、威胁和仇恨言论(第3节)。
在“没有妇女有权杀害未出生的婴儿! 她选择杀死的不是婴儿的身体。 ”这个模型正确地将“选择杀人”确定为AL,
然而,这在实践中只是一个小错误,因为这一跨度本身已适当本地化。

blocks.en:
Missing context. Our approach also struggles when abusive meaning relies on external cultural knowledge.
In the example “ maga white cookouts would be nice. ”, annotated as implicit hate in IHC, the model predicts no AL span.
Without familiarity with “ maga ” (a U.S. political slogan) and the implicit connotations of “ white cookouts ”, the message appears benign at the lexical level.
Such errors suggest that implicit AL detection depends on world knowledge that span-level modeling alone cannot fully capture, and may require broader training coverage of implicit phenomena or access to additional contextual information.
blocks.zh:
缺少上下文。 当滥用性的意义依赖于外部文化知识时,我们的做法也会挣扎。
以“maga 白色烹饪会很好......”为例,
在不熟悉“maga”(美国的一个政治口号)和“白色烹饪”的隐含含义的情况下,这一信息在词汇层面上似乎是良性的。
这种错误表明,隐含的AL检测取决于仅靠跨级模型无法充分捕捉的世界知识,可能需要对隐含现象进行更广泛的培训,或获取更多的背景资料。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion and future work
blocks.zh: 7. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
Conclusion. In this paper, we compared abusive language identification (ALI), a sequence labeling task, with abusive language classification (ALC) across three transformer encoders and multiple training corpora, evaluating cross-domain generalization on HatEval, IHC, JL-Hate, and TRuST under a conservative sentence-level protocol for ALI predictions.
We also provided span level analysis, where ALI recovers AL and target segments on overlap-based metrics but struggles with exact boundaries (F1-exact below 30 30 % for AL spans and around 31 31 % for target spans), showing that fine-grained identification remains challenging.
Conserning sentence level analysis, ALI matches or outperforms ALC on average on every test set despite a conservative binarization of its token predictions, with the largest gains on JL-Hate ( + 12.2 +12.2 macro-F1) and TRuST ( + 11.5 +11.5 ) and a narrower margin on HatEval ( + 3.5 +3.5 ).
ALI is also more robust: when trained on TBO, ALC collapses on several test sets (e.g., HateBERT on IHC: 27.41 27.41 %) while ALI remains stable ( 59.46 59.46 %), and ALI suffers less from the limited size of our pilot corpus.
Finally, ALI improves implicit AL detection over ALC ( + 3.6 +3.6 macro-F1 on IHC) without trading off explicit AL detection, while additionally providing localized, interpretable outputs.
Our qualitative analyses highlight the difficulties faced by ALI models trained on our small pilot corpus, and underscore the need for annotation according to the hierarchical AL taxonomy.
blocks.zh:
结论。 在本文中,我们比较了滥用语言识别(ALI),这是一个序列标签任务,与滥用语言分类(ALC)跨越了3个变相器编码器和多所训练的corpora,在HatEval,IHC,JL-Hate,以及TRuST上根据一个保守的ALI预测的句子级协议来评价跨域通用.
我们还提供了跨度分析,其中ALI恢复了基于重叠的计量标准中的AL部分和目标部分,但与精确的边界(AL段低于30%的F1-精确度,目标段约为31%)有冲突,这表明精细的识别仍然具有挑战性。
合并句子水平分析,ALI在每套测试中平均匹配或超过ALC,尽管其信使预测有保守的二进制,在JL-Hate(+12.2+12.2宏-F1)和TRuST(+11.5+11.5)上收益最大,在HatEval(+3.5+3.5)上的比值更窄.
ALI也更加强大:在接受TBO培训时,ALC在几套测试中崩溃了(例如IHC上的HateBERT:27.41 27.41%),而ALI保持稳定(59.46 59.46%),而ALI较少受到我们的试飞器的有限影响.
最后,ALI改进了对ALC的隐含AL检测(+3.6+3.6 宏-F1在IHC上),而不以显性AL检测为交换条件,同时也提供了局部,可解释的产出.
我们的定性分析突出表明了接受过小型实验体培训的ALI模型所面临的困难,并强调需要根据分类法进行注释。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Annotating a corpus using our proposed granularity remains a difficult and costly task: token-level agreement is limited (mean pairwise Cohen’s κ = 0.38 \kappa=0.38 ), reflecting the complexity of span-boundary decisions.
Our study nevertheless demonstrates the feasibility of ALI with approximately 1000 samples (English-only), sufficient to validate the approach, although a larger scale (10k+ samples) would be required to reach the operational robustness expected in production.
Our qualitative analysis shows that confusion between subcategories (notably Threat and Hate speech ) reflects the intrinsic difficulty of fine taxonomy on short spans, and partly explains lower scores on HatEval where this distinction is semantically critical.
The out-of-domain corpora use heterogeneous definitions and annotation schemes, which limits the direct comparability of results across datasets.
Target–AL linking remains preliminary because our experiments identify target spans without explicitly associating each target with its corresponding AL span.
blocks.zh:
用我们拟议的颗粒度来说明一项文书仍然是一项困难而昂贵的任务:象征性协议是有限的(平均双向Cohen's $ = 0.38\kappa= 0.38),反映了跨边界决定的复杂性。
然而,我们的研究显示,采用大约1000个样本(只有英文样本)的ALI是可行的,足以验证这一方法,尽管需要更大的规模(10克+样本)才能达到生产中预期的操作稳健性。
我们的定性分析表明,亚类(特别是威胁和仇恨言论)之间的混淆反映了在短时期内细分类的内在困难,并部分解释了HatEval的分数较低的原因,因为这种区分在本质上至关重要。
域外公司采用不同的定义和注释办法,限制了各数据集结果的直接可比性。
目标-AL连接仍然是初步的,因为我们的实验确定了目标跨度,而没有明确地将每个目标与相应的AL跨度联系起来。

blocks.en: Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Handling data containing abusive language raises important ethical concerns. An explicit warning about the sensitive nature of the content was provided to annotators from the start of the process. Regular rest periods and emotional support were made available, and they were free to discontinue participation at any time. We are aware that the datasets used may contain biases related to annotator choices or data sources, and we encourage future work to mitigate them.
blocks.zh: 处理含有虐待性语言的数据引起了重要的道德问题。 从过程开始,就向注释者明确警告内容的敏感性。 提供定期休息和精神支持,他们可以随时自由停止参与。 我们认识到,所使用的数据集可能含有与注释者选择或数据来源有关的偏差,我们鼓励今后开展工作来减少这些偏差。

blocks.en:
Combining TBO with either corpus degrades ALI on IHC and HatEval, likely because TBO’s targeted offensive spans sit outside the broader AL categories of those test sets (e.g., RoBERTa on IHC: 61.13 61.13 % → \rightarrow 42.82 42.82 %), whereas adding HX to our corpus improves ALI on IHC ( + 6.1 +6.1 to + 8.6 +8.6 ; best: 70.48 70.48 %) and JL-Hate (up to 78.27 78.27 %) but can hurt HatEval (RoBERTa: 65.58 65.58 % → \rightarrow 58.03 58.03 %).
The same pattern holds on TRuST: adding TBO to our corpus drops ALI sharply (fBERT 71.97 71.97 % → \rightarrow 61.54 61.54 %; RoBERTa 75.53 75.53 % → \rightarrow 58.23 58.23 %), the three-corpus mixture is the weakest ALI setting for every backbone ( 44.64 44.64 – 45.98 45.98 %), and combining our corpus with HX stays within one point of the best ALI ( 70.86 70.86 – 74.93 74.93 %).
Merging therefore helps when the added spans enrich the evaluated phenomenon and hurts when they introduce out-of-scope AL types; on the TBO mixtures, ALC reverses this ordering and gains from HX ( 42.23 42.23 % → \rightarrow 64.48 64.48 % for fBERT), which suggests that sentence labels from HX rescue the sentence-level decision while token supervision is diluted.
blocks.zh:
将TBO与任何一种物状结合起来都会降低IHC和HatEval的ALI, 很可能是因为TBO有针对性的攻击跨度超出了这些测试组中较广的AL类(例如,IHC上的RoBERTa:61.13 61.13% → 右倾 42.82 42.82 %),而将HX添加到我们体内则能改善IHC的ALI(+6.1+6.1+ 8.6+8.6;最好:70.48 70.48%)和JL-Hate(高达78.27 78.27%),但会伤害HatEval(RoBERTa:65.58.65.588% → 右倾58.03 %)。
TRuST也有同样的模式:将TBO添加到我们体内会急剧下降(fBERT 71.97 71.97% →\正线 61.54 61.54%;RoBERTa 75.53 75.53% →\正线 58.23 58.23 %),三体混合物是每个骨干中最弱的ALI设置(44.64 44.64–45.98 45.98 %),将我们体内与HX的结合保持在最佳ALI的一分之一(70.86 70.86–74.93 74.93 %)以内.
因此,如果增加的跨度丰富了被评价的现象,并在引入范围外的AL类型时造成伤害,合并会有所帮助;在TBO混合物上,ALC将这种订单和收益从HX(42.23 42.23% =\rightarrow 64.48 64.48% for fBERT)中倒置,这表明HX的句子标签拯救了句子层面的决定,同时淡化了象征性的监督。

blocks.en:
Significant standard vs with target differences are configuration-specific:
fBERT favors standard Ours on all three AL metrics; HateBERT favors Ours (with target) but standard TBO ; RoBERTa favors Ours (with target) on F1-exact and F1-partial while standard Ours remains higher on F1-token.
No significant paired difference is observed for Ours + TBO across backbones.
For Target exact, Ours (with target) is significantly better than TBO (with target) for fBERT and HateBERT ( † for fBERT under the best-vs-all criterion), while the RoBERTa gap is not significant.
These patterns support a backbone-dependent effect of target supervision on AL span detection, while target-span gains are more consistent for Ours-vs-TBO in two out of three backbones.
